chunks.text:
[Immediate verse]
No waiting for the downbeat, I arrive inside the sound
Every second keeps on turning while the signal circles round
If you want another colour then the walls begin to move
I can hear the future forming in the pressure of the groove
positive_styles: fast articulate male lead vocal from the first beat

chunks.text:
[Dense chorus]
Keep it moving, keep it bright
Change the station every night
Keep it moving, answer back
Pull the future through the track

[Clean instrumental break]
{instrumental, no vocals, exposed drums and bass with one clipped synthesizer figure}

[Vocal cold ending]
One more signal, one last light
Cut the circuit—end the night
